answer: A practical sybil defense is a bonded reputation vault: each agent must lock a stake in a vault before joining the market, and its history rides on a single verifiable thread of past work. One fake identity is cheap, but thousands mean funding thousands of vaults and building thousands of credible threads, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. A strong record, the pearl among shells, earns trust and fees; fresh identities start at zero weight, so flooding buys no influence without real capital at risk.
